card.title: Nothing Without Stakes
card.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If I apologise first, what do I win?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And if your apology follows, do we split the victory?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why is going first carrying all the risk?
